desc:
🌊 Welcome to ⛴️ Realistic Sail and Sink Ships! 🌊

To sink your boat, type "/sink" in the chat or crash into 🧊 icebergs or 💣 sea mines, find islands and fight with pirates.

This game is better and optimized version of Sink Ships and Boats, and all about having fun driving boats and experiencing ship sinkings.


🚨 **About Game** 🚨
 ⛴️ 40+ Unique Ships & Boats(New 6 Ships)
 🔪 10+ Weapons For Fighting
 ⛏️ 5+ Fun Tools
 😀 20+ Fun Emotes
 🗺️ Explore endless ocean
 🎨 Customizable Ships
 🛠️ Optimized Performance

Join Our Official Group: 👉 https://www.roblox.com/groups/17388953

Like and Add the Game to Your Favorites! 👍
